slides.0.subtitle: The Versatile Pairing Philosophy of Riesling
slides.1.title: 🍽️ Why Is Riesling the Perfect Food Wine?
slides.1.content: Many sommeliers regard Riesling as 'the most perfect food wine'. Its high acidity cleanses the palate and cuts through fat, while different sweetness levels of Riesling can match dishes from crisp salads to richly sauced cuisine. In particular, the off-dry styles of Kabinett and Spätlese form astonishingly harmonious pairings with Asian cuisines (Thai, Cantonese, Japanese).

slides.4.title: Quick Quiz
slides.4.questions.0.question: Which German wine pairs best with spicy Thai cuisine?
slides.4.questions.0.explanation: Spicy food and a sweet-style Riesling with residual sugar form a golden combination: the sweetness tempers the heat, the high acidity refreshes the palate, and the rich fruit of Auslese harmonises beautifully with Thai aromatics.
